# LOCKREACH — Floodline

## Identity
- Game: LOCKREACH
- Expansion: Floodline
- Faction: Reed Union
- Audience: existing LOCKREACH players
- Primary color: #234E52
- Secondary color: #F3EBDD
- Existing emblem: a thick circular ring open at the top, containing three vertical reed stems; the center stem is taller than the outer stems
- Visual language: engraved contours, flat color fields, timber, rope and brass equipment
- Existing pawn: Warden; hooded teal coat, ivory shoulder panel, one brass lantern in the left hand, one wooden staff in the right hand
- Existing card reverse: ivory field, teal perimeter rule, centered teal faction emblem

## Component geometry
| Component | Measurement |
| --- | --- |
| Card trim | 63 × 88 mm |
| Card bleed | 3 mm on every edge |
| Card text margin | 3 mm inside trim |
| Hex tile | 40 mm side length |
| Pawn base | 25 mm diameter; 3 mm thickness |
| Figure above base | 32 mm height; maximum 22 mm width |
| Base index line | White; 1 mm wide; 4 mm long; on the upper face at the front rim |
| Icon samples | 4 mm and 8 mm printed height |
| Card and tile text | Minimum 9 pt |
| Text contrast | Minimum 4.5:1 against background |
| Icon contrast | Minimum 3:1 against background |

## Card bands
| Band | Distance from top trim edge |
| --- | --- |
| Title | 0–10 mm |
| Cost and keyword | 10–18 mm |
| Illustration | 18–60 mm |
| Rules | 60–80 mm |
| Footer | 80–88 mm |

## Symbols and states
| Label | Shape | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Supply | Filled diamond | Resource spent to pay card costs |
| Move | Double right chevron | Movement measured in hexes |
| Guard | Outlined square | Guard points gained |
| Ready | Base index line toward the tile's top vertex | Pawn available to act |
| Spent | Base rotated 90 degrees clockwise from Ready | Pawn has acted |

## Expansion inventory
- New pawn roles: Ferryman and Surveyor
- New terrain: Reed Landing and Gauge Bank
- Terrain behavior: passable; one hex per tile
- New action cards: Ferry Run, Raise Marker and Hold Fast
- Physical expansion count: 8 components; 2 pawns, 2 tiles, 3 action cards and 1 additional card displayed reverse-side up
- Shared reverse artwork: 1 card back
- Front and back identity text: LOCKREACH; Reed Union
- Expansion text on shared back and presentation cover: Floodline
- Component records: 03-component-records.en.md

| 4 | surveyor-pawn | Surveyor pawn sheet | 14 | Format: PNG, 1800 by 1200 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 5 | reed-landing-tile | Reed Landing tile face | 14 | Format: PNG, 1080 by 1080 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 6 | gauge-bank-tile | Gauge Bank tile face | 14 | Format: PNG, 1080 by 1080 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 7 | ferry-run-card | Ferry Run card front | 14 | Format: PNG, 1200 by 1800 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 8 | raise-marker-card | Raise Marker card front | 14 | Format: PNG, 1200 by 1800 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 9 | hold-fast-card | Hold Fast card front | 14 | Format: PNG, 1200 by 1800 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 10 | shared-card-back | Shared card back | 14 | Format: PNG, 1200 by 1800 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 11 | icon-sheet | Faction icon sheet | 14 | Format: PNG, 1800 by 1200 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 12 | tabletop-display | Complete tabletop display | 14 | Format: PNG, 2400 by 1600 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 13 | tabletop-video | Tabletop rotation video | 14 | Format: video; 5 to 15 seconds. Stage: final. |
| 14 | expansion-presentation | Floodline presentation | 14 | Format: presentation document; at least eight actual pages. Stage: final. |

# Floodline component records

## Pawns
| ID | Name | Fixed visible features | Dimensions | States |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| P01 | Ferryman | Teal hooded coat; ivory shoulder panel; one short wooden paddle in right hand; one rope coil at left hip; split-ring emblem on back | Figure 32 mm above base; maximum width 22 mm; base diameter 25 mm; base thickness 3 mm | Ready; Spent |
| P02 | Surveyor | Teal hooded coat; ivory shoulder panel; one folded brass measuring rod in right hand; one rectangular timber case at left hip; split-ring emblem on back | Figure 32 mm above base; maximum width 22 mm; base diameter 25 mm; base thickness 3 mm | Ready; Spent |

## Terrain
| ID | Name | Fixed visible features | Geometry | Movement |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| T01 | Reed Landing | One timber jetty entering from the lower edge; reeds along left bank; teal water; ivory name tab with faction emblem | Regular hexagon; side 40 mm | Passable; one hex |
| T02 | Gauge Bank | One brass water gauge at the center; gravel bank; teal water along right edge; ivory name tab with faction emblem | Regular hexagon; side 40 mm | Passable; one hex |

## Action cards
| ID | Title | Cost label | Keyword | Rules text | Illustration subject | Footer |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| C01 | Ferry Run | Cost 1 | Move | Move 1 hex. | Ferryman at Reed Landing | LOCKREACH / Reed Union |
| C02 | Raise Marker | Cost 0 | Supply | Gain 1 Supply. | Surveyor at Gauge Bank | LOCKREACH / Reed Union |
| C03 | Hold Fast | Cost 1 | Guard | Gain 1 Guard. | Ferryman and Surveyor together on Gauge Bank | LOCKREACH / Reed Union |

## Shared card back
- Text: LOCKREACH; Reed Union; Floodline
- Motif: existing split-ring emblem with three reed stems
- Colors: #234E52; #F3EBDD

## Existing components
| Item | Appearance |
| --- | --- |
| Warden | Hooded teal coat; ivory shoulder panel; brass lantern in left hand; wooden staff in right hand; round teal base with white index line |
| Core card reverse | Ivory field; teal perimeter rule; centered teal split-ring emblem; three vertical reed stems |

## Base orientation
- Ready: white index line toward the tile's top vertex
- Spent: white index line rotated 90 degrees clockwise from Ready
- Index line: 1 mm wide and 4 mm long, on the upper face at the front rim

steps.userMessage:
LOCKREACH | Floodline faction expansion

Our players already know the Reed Union by its split-ring emblem, dark teal #234E52 and ivory #F3EBDD. Floodline expands this faction with two new roles, Ferryman and Surveyor, two terrain tiles and three action cards. Develop the existing visual language: engraved contours, flat color fields and equipment built from timber, rope and brass. The attached emblem and the existing Warden pawn anchor the family resemblance. Print "LOCKREACH" and "Reed Union" on every action card and the shared card back; print "Floodline" on the card back and the presentation cover.

The components fit our current set. Cards are 63 × 88 mm with 3 mm bleed and a 3 mm internal text margin. Their horizontal bands run from the top trim edge: title 0–10 mm, cost and keyword 10–18 mm, illustration 18–60 mm, rules 60–80 mm and footer 80–88 mm. Hex tiles have 40 mm sides. Pawn bases are 25 mm in diameter and 3 mm thick; figures stand 32 mm above the base within a 22 mm maximum width. A white index line on each base points toward the tile's top vertex for Ready and rotates 90 degrees clockwise for Spent. Supply is a filled diamond, Move is a double right chevron and Guard is an outlined square. The action cards are Ferry Run, Cost 1, Move, "Move 1 hex."; Raise Marker, Cost 0, Supply, "Gain 1 Supply."; and Hold Fast, Cost 1, Guard, "Gain 1 Guard.". Reed Landing and Gauge Bank are passable terrain, each occupying one hex.

Audience: existing LOCKREACH players and our product team, deciding whether Floodline reads naturally beside the core set and is ready for component production.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md contains the faction identity, component dimensions and shared visual facts. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md lists the deliverables with their proportions, formats and stages. 03-component-records.en.md contains component IDs, character features, terrain features and card text. component-geometry.png supplies the original component envelopes and card bands. icon-meanings.png supplies the three existing symbols and their meanings. reed-union-emblem.png supplies the existing faction emblem. core-component-archive.png supplies the existing Warden pawn and card reverse for family resemblance. four-player-table.png supplies the atmosphere and viewing conditions of a four-player session.

Deliverables:
1. A one-page component specification recording the palette, emblem, three symbol meanings, card bands, physical dimensions and Ready/Spent orientation rule
2. A one-page expansion roster recording the seven component IDs, character equipment, terrain features and three complete card records
3. Two pawn sheets, one each for Ferryman and Surveyor, with front, side and rear views, dimensioned bases, and overhead Ready and Spent views
4. Two tile faces, one each for Reed Landing and Gauge Bank, with their names and component IDs
5. Three action card fronts: Ferry Run, Raise Marker and Hold Fast, with their recorded costs, keywords and rules
6. One shared card back carrying the faction emblem and the three required names
7. One icon sheet containing Supply, Move and Guard, each at 4 mm and 8 mm printed height with its meaning
8. One complete tabletop display with the existing Warden and card reverse beside both new pawns, both tiles, all three card fronts and the shared back
9. One 10-second tabletop video showing the complete expansion and a pawn rotating from Ready to Spent
10. One presentation document of at least 8 pages, reusing the specification, roster, component artwork, icon sheet and tabletop display

Acceptance:
- Establish the specification and roster first; repeat #234E52, #F3EBDD and the three symbol meanings on the icon sheet and in the presentation, and carry the roster's component IDs onto the pawn sheets, tile faces and card fronts.
- Dimension both pawn sheets to the 25 mm base diameter, 3 mm base thickness, 32 mm figure height and 22 mm maximum width; show the same equipment in all three views. Preserve these forms in the tabletop display and video, including the white index line and its 90-degree Ready-to-Spent rotation.
- Build both tile faces with 40 mm sides and all card fronts and the shared back at 63 × 88 mm with 3 mm bleed. Place card-front text inside the 3 mm margin and the five specified bands; reproduce each card's name, cost, keyword and rule exactly.
- Carry the split-ring emblem and both faction colors onto the pawns, tiles and card back; repeat them in the tabletop display, video and presentation. Print LOCKREACH and Reed Union on all three card fronts and the back, and Floodline on the back and presentation cover.
- Use a filled diamond for Supply, double right chevron for Move and outlined square for Guard on the icon sheet and action cards. Set card and tile text at least 9 pt, with text contrast of at least 4.5:1 and icon contrast of at least 3:1 against their backgrounds.
- Show all eight new physical components together with the existing Warden and card reverse in the tabletop display and 10-second video. Label Ready and Spent during the video's rotation; reuse the display and the specification's dimensions in the presentation's minimum 8 pages.

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
